title: Norway, Sweden to provide over $370 million in weapons funding for Ukraine
summary: Norway's contribution will amount to $300 million to NATO's Prioritized Ukraine Requirements List (PURL), which funds U.S. weapons purchases for Ukraine. While Sweden will provide 720 million Swedish Krona (approximately $71 million) for various Ukrainian weapons initiatives, including PURL.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,629,010 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 1,970 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: 2 Russian oil refineries reportedly targeted in overnight drone attack on Krasnodar Krai
summary: The Ilsky and Afipsky refineries are both located in Krasnodar Krai's Seversky district and have been repeatedly targeted in Ukrainian drone attacks.

title: Germany, UK push back after US criticizes Ukraine's deep strikes into Russia
summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius strongly rejected Colby's assessment, calling criticism of Ukrainian strikes against strategic military targets inside Russia "quite a stupid thing."

title: International hockey federation hit by cyberattack after Russia barred from World Juniors
summary: The perpetrators have not been identified. Before the website went offline, an image of Russian hockey players appeared alongside a message reading, “SCARED TO FACE RUSSIA? You banned the only team you can't beat.”
